title: A game-server shutdown notifies a connected wizard and restores its saved position
notes: After the included walk and relog establish a saved position, this scenario gracefully stops the game server
with the wizard connected, records the flushed MSG_SERVERSHUTDOWN notice, captures the client's screen, starts
the game server again, and requires the wizard to enter at the same saved position.

steps.name: the game server shuts down with the wizard connected
the shutdown notice is flushed to the session
steps.pattern: Sent MSG_SERVERSHUTDOWN with Message=\d+ to (\d+) session\(s\); 0 notice\(s\) were still unwritten

steps.name: the client opens its game-server maintenance notice
steps.pattern: DisplayMessageBox\( msg = Server has been brought down for maintenance\.\s+Please try again later!, title = INFO, msg string key = GUI_ServerShutdown

steps.name: the client shows the game-server shutdown notice
close the client after recording its shutdown notice
start the client again after the server is ready
the restarted client brings its renderer up
the restarted client is at login
log in after the server restart
the login server accepts the returning client
the login server admits the returning client
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the returning character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the returning client reaches character selection
play the wizard after the server restart

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the wizard returns to its saved position after restart
the client loads the restored zone
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard \d+ stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard is back after the server restart
